name: Fraboni et al. Prefix Selection
aliases: Prefix Selection via Total Variation Distance
definition: A prefix selection method that takes into account both Jacobian variations and scattering functions, updated with shifts and scattering function similarity.
summary: Fraboni et al. Prefix Selection is a stochastic filtering mechanism for multi-view path tracing that rejects shifted prefixes with mismatched scattering distributions to reduce noise and prevent bias artifacts.
